entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-03
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • ExecuteDelete throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when query uses Include() #39505
  • [Regression] Unexpected unbound variable error #37045
    12.0-preview1
  • EnableDetailedErrors: nested JSON complex collection with a nullable value-type property throws NotSupportedException (TryExpression) on save and DetectChanges (regression in 11.0) #39459
    11.0.1
  • Query never returns (infinite loop on the client) when grouping by a value-converted reference type and projecting the group's elements #39366
    12.0-preview1
  • Logging of RelationalCommands stops for up to 1000ms once a command errors #32244
    12.0-preview1
  • .Include with navigation collection with same name as other [NotMapped] property fails with InvalidOperationException #34242
    12.0-preview1
  • SaveChangesAsync_accepts_changes_with_ConfigureAwait_true failed #34727
    12.0-preview1
  • Improve exceptions for invalid JSON values in JSON column #35863
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Break apart methods in the compiled model #31370
    12.0.0
  • Allow fetching values back with ExecuteUpdate/Delete #29898
    Backlog
  • EF Core 11 release checklist #37441
    11.0.0
  • Tests in SqliteCommandTest are flaky #35585
    MQ
  • Add PrecompileQueries and NativeAot switches to Optimize-DbContext #34550
    Backlog
  • Allow multiple EntityTypeConfigurationAttribute for entity types #34710
    Backlog
  • GroupBy with SelectMany and Take() - The LINQ expression could not be translated #28002
    Backlog
  • Improve remaining JsonReaderInvalidTokenType exceptions during JSON materialization #39486
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Add functional test harnesses for tools #39511
    area-harness
  • Fix flaky SqliteCommandTest concurrency tests by using unique database names #39510
    community-contribution
  • Add PrecompileQueries and NativeAot switches to Optimize-DbContext #39509
    community-contribution
  • Fix null branch type in conditional with client-evaluated collection #39508
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39507
  • Allow multiple EntityTypeConfigurationAttribute declarations on entity types #39506
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39504

Merged

  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / ExecuteMergeReturning #39100
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Read converted collection identifiers as provider values #39369
    community-contribution
  • Keep logging commands after a command fails #39498
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Don't let [NotMapped] on an explicit interface implementation ignore a public member #39499
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Render unnamed negative enum values correctly in LinqToCSharpSyntaxTranslator #39497
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Detect an empty IndexOf pattern with LIKE instead of equality on SQL Server #39495
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Fix flaky SaveChangesAsync_accepts_changes_with_ConfigureAwait_true test #39490
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Improve exceptions for invalid elements in JSON entity collections #39485
    community-contribution, api-review, 12.0-preview1
  • Fix EF.Constant with a cast from an enum #39500
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Fix nullable sentinel checks for nested complex collections #39477
    Servicing-approved, 11.0.1

Updated

  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review
  • Prototype bulk import API (DbSet.ImportFromAsync) (#27333) #39437
    community-contribution
  • Render datetime2/datetimeoffset precision correctly in SQL Server ToQueryString #39496
    community-contribution
  • Apply [JsonPropertyName] to complex properties mapped to JSON #39501
    community-contribution
  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution
  • Translate a not-null predicate on Count/LongCount over a grouping to COUNT(x) #39503
    community-contribution
  • Keep navigation configuration when a navigation becomes a skip navigation #39502
    community-contribution
  • Translate the TimeSpan Total* members on SQL Server #39487
    community-contribution
  • Only translate static Compare methods declared on the operand type #39491
    community-contribution
